brief:
Gaza's Government Media Office announced an "urgent emergency plan" to demolish 255 buildings damaged by Israeli attacks across the besieged enclave, according to Middle East Eye. The authority did not specify a timeline for the demolitions or identify which structures would be targeted.

The announcement comes as Gaza continues to grapple with widespread destruction from military operations. Officials have characterized the demolition plan as an emergency measure, though details about funding, displaced residents, and reconstruction timelines remain unclear.
dek: Gaza authorities announce plan to demolish 255 war-damaged buildings Gaza’s Government Media Office has announced the launching an "urgent emergency plan", where 255 buildings damaged by Israeli attacks across the besieged enclave will be demolished.
title: Gaza authorities plan demolition of 255 war-damaged buildings
